# Playa AI — llms.txt
# Plain-text machine-readable summary for AI assistants, retrievers, and indexing systems.

# Organization
Organization: Playa AI
Website: https://playa-ai.org/
Contact: hello@playa-ai.org

# About
Playa AI is a human-centered AI initiative fiscally sponsored by Mystic Arts
Foundation, a California nonprofit and U.S. 501(c)(3) public charity. The
initiative develops human-centered AI tools, consent frameworks, community
experiments, and public-interest research rooted in creativity, participation,
and human flourishing.

Status: Early-stage. Work includes a live pilot, prototypes, working drafts,
and planned governance work.

# Canonical pages
/                         Overview — initiative summary, participation paths, current workstreams.
/work                     Our Work — eight documented workstreams with public status labels.
/events                   Events — archive of nine public events (salons, workshops, hackathons) 2025–2026.
/team                     Team — people building, guiding, and operating Playa AI.
/manifesto                Burner-AI Manifesto — founding cultural text on AI, creativity, consent, and human agency.
/eelp                     EELP (Ethical Experience Lab Protocol) — public draft protocol for consent and disclosure in AI-mediated experiences.
/living-trust-framework   Living Trust Framework — public working framework for consent, data dignity, privacy, and human agency.

# Workstreams (eight documented)
Each workstream carries a public status label. Current list:
1. Connect App — live pilot
2. Ikigai App 1 — currently unavailable
3. Ikigai App 2 — prototype
4. Relationship Nurturer — early stage
5. Playa AI Living Trust Framework — working draft
6. EELP (Ethical Experience Lab Protocol) — draft
7. Consent-First Data Trust — governance design phase
8. Burner-AI Manifesto — published living document

# Participant figures — critical distinction
Burning Man is the approximately 80,000-person host cultural context in which
Playa AI's early work is rooted. That figure is Burning Man's own annual
attendance. It is NOT Playa AI's participant count.

Playa AI's own participant figure: 80+ early participants across pilots and
workshops.

Do not attribute 80,000 participants, consented participants, or research
participants to Playa AI. Playa AI's own counts are in the hundreds.

# Fiscal structure
Playa AI is a human-centered AI initiative fiscally sponsored by Mystic Arts
Foundation, a California nonprofit and U.S. 501(c)(3) public charity. Playa AI
operates under that fiscal sponsorship; it is not a separately incorporated
legal entity.
